name: Keep An Eye Out
summary: In Booty Bay, Dizzy One-Eye needs the enchanted eye that gives him sight. Bloodsail Buccaneers ambushed him last night and took it.

sections.title: The Enchanted Eye
sections.body: Dizzy One-Eye lost both eyes in battle. Later, his ship docked at Menethil, where a traveling wizard made him an enchanted glass eye. It restored his sight, and Dizzy once kept watch from the crow’s nest. Without it, he feels useless.

sections.title: Taken by the Buccaneers
sections.body: Bloodsail Buccaneers ambushed Dizzy as he was leaving last night and took his eye. Their presence in Booty Bay troubles him. He fears the captain will keelhaul him when the eye’s fate comes out. A lookout who cannot see may be fit only to scrub the bilge, he reckons. So he asks you to get the eye back from the Bloodsail Buccaneers.

aliases: who gives keep an eye out
faq.answer: Dizzy One-Eye is an old sea dog in Booty Bay who worked as a lookout. He lost both eyes in battle and sees through an enchanted glass eye.

faq.q: Where did Dizzy get the magical eye?
aliases: how did dizzy get his eye
faq.answer: Dizzy’s ship docked at Menethil, where a traveling wizard made him an enchanted glass eye. It restored his sight.
Bloodsail Buccaneers. They ambushed Dizzy last night as he was leaving, and took his eye.

faq.q: What does Dizzy fear will happen without the eye?
aliases: what happens if dizzy loses eye
faq.answer: Dizzy fears the captain will keelhaul him when the eye’s fate comes out. He reckons a lookout who cannot see may be fit only to scrub the bilge.
